views.title: Split report
views.statement: Show the documents written from one scanned PDF, the source pages in each result, and pages omitted as confirmed blanks.

views.title: Inbox processing report
views.statement: Show which unseen PDFs were processed into the Paperless consume folder and record their content hashes so unchanged inputs are not processed twice.

states.title: Loading
states.statement: Pages are rendering and OCR is extracting text, layout, and visual features.

states.title: Empty
states.statement: The input contains no pages that can produce an output document.

states.title: Failed
states.statement: Rendering, OCR, or model loading failed and the command returns the actionable error.

states.title: Loading
states.statement: Unseen input PDFs are being checked and split.

states.title: Empty
states.statement: Every input PDF is already recorded at its current content hash.

states.title: Failed
states.statement: A PDF could not be processed and remains eligible for a later retry.

requirements.title: Write split documents
requirements.statement: The splitter writes one PDF per predicted document and reports the source pages in each output.

requirements.title: Omit only confirmed blank pages
requirements.statement: A page is omitted only when it has no OCR text and no visual content.

requirements.title: Process each input version once
requirements.statement: The inbox stores a content hash after processing and processes a changed PDF again.

requirements.title: Deliver to the consume folder
requirements.statement: Each predicted document is written to the Paperless consume folder with a stable input-derived prefix.

stories.title: Split a scan stack
stories.statement: A person turns one scan stack into individually consumable document PDFs.

stories.title: Process an inbox
stories.statement: A person processes newly arrived scans without duplicating unchanged inputs.
